title: 1-Hour Seine Sightseeing Cruise from the Eiffel Tower
description: The classic first taste of Paris from the water — a relaxed 1-hour cruise departing right at the foot of the Eiffel Tower, gliding past Notre-Dame, the Louvre, and Île de la Cité with multilingual audio commentary.
imageAlt: The Eiffel Tower and Pont d'Iéna bridge above the Seine River in Paris
bestFor: First-time visitors who want the classic view

title: Evening Seine River Cruise with Live Music
description: The same iconic route after dark, with ambient live music on board and open-air deck seating — every bridge and monument lit up as you glide past, the Eiffel Tower sparkling on the hour.
imageAlt: A river cruise boat gliding past illuminated buildings on the Seine at night

title: Seine River Cruise with Lunch or Crêpe Tasting
description: Combine the sightseeing cruise with a relaxed lunch or a sweet crêpe tasting on board — a slower-paced way to enjoy the Seine while sampling French classics as the city drifts by.
imageAlt: The Louvre Museum along the Seine River banks in Paris during the day
bestFor: Travelers who want sightseeing plus a real meal on the water

title: Eiffel Tower Elevator Access + Seine Cruise Combo
description: See Paris twice — first from above on the Eiffel Tower's elevator to the 2nd floor, then from below on a 1-hour Seine cruise. Two of the city's best views, booked as one skip-the-line ticket.
includes: Skip-the-line Eiffel Tower elevator access (2nd floor)
imageAlt: The Eiffel Tower glowing above the Seine River at golden hour with a cruise boat passing
bestFor: First-timers who want the tower and the river in one day
